summary: Controls how far a Stability control or style-transfer operation may depart from its input image. Lower values preserve more source structure; higher values permit broader changes driven by the prompt and control reference.
combines: Meaningful only on an operation that supplies the required input image or control reference; it is not a text-to-image parameter.
It interacts with style, structure, fidelity, and control-strength settings, so exposing it without an explicit operation contract would make the result ambiguous.
Lixpi derives operation-specific strengths internally. User-configurable edit strength remains outside this iteration.
note: Operation-specific style-transfer control; not implemented in this iteration.
